        elif x == "bioreactor":

    # Maximize total priority

    # Quantum workflow using D-Wave Ocean

    bind_params = qubo.to_ising(binary_variables=True).to_dict()

        # Evaluate the achieved priority

        results.append((objective_quality, constraint_violation_rate, penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy, job.runtime, job.evaluation_cost, achieved_priority, selected_experiments))

    # Return the average values

    feasible_objective_quality = np.mean(feasible_objective_quality)

    return {
        "feasible_objective_quality": feasible_objective_quality,
